visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a central male figure standing bound to a wooden post. He is surrounded by a crowd of people, including men, women, and children. A woman in the foreground is gesturing toward him, while a young boy on the left holds a hatchet. The setting appears to be a village with a thatched-roof structure in the background.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: He found him, standing with one arm cast about the protecting post, and breathing thick and hard, after his exertions, but disdaining to permit a single sign of suffering to escape. His person was now protected by immemorial and sacred usage, until the tribe in council had deliberated and determined on his fate.
